description.en: Removes a character from the party with no message: RemovePartyCmnd(_paramID, _flg_st_reset, !_flg_st_reset). So with _flg_st_reset true the member is removed and their saved record deleted; with false the removal routine is called with its pt_lock flag set.
Parameter ID of the character to remove, e.g. "para_cp0010".
true to also delete the character's saved record, so they start over if they join again. The shipped calls pass false.

examples.case: Removing a member silently (real usage, from ev42020900.nut)
